$schema: internal — not a Discord-published manifest format
purpose: Canonical declaration of the Discord server + bot config the operator creates in the developer portal UI on Day 2 14:00. Source-of-truth if the server or bot needs to be re-created.

channels.name: daily-brief
channels.purpose: Daily morning briefing and weekly/monthly summaries. Posted by the agent (Phase 1+) at the configured cadence.

channels.name: signals
channels.purpose: Per-signal-cycle posts: each candidate signal (long/short/flat) and operator-decision summary at 17:30 ET.

channels.name: fills
channels.purpose: Order fills (full + partial), cancellations, rejections. One post per fill event.

channels.name: alerts
channels.purpose: P1/P2 operational alerts: reconciliation breaks, vol-regime trips, margin warnings, calendar-unratified reminders.

channels.name: critical
channels.purpose: P0 alerts requiring immediate operator attention: kill-switch triggered, audit chain break, hash-chain integrity failures, halt-new transitions.

channels.name: ops
channels.purpose: Slash-command surface for operator-invoked actions: /positions, /halt, /resume, /ratify, /vacation, /diary. Bot responses thread here.

channels.name: audit
channels.purpose: Append-only mirror of selected audit_log events (never the entire stream — high-signal subset). Useful for at-a-glance integrity verification on mobile.

phase_2_additions.name: ask-agent
phase_2_additions.purpose: Q&A surface for /ask command (frontend-spec.md §1615). NOT created on Day 2 — added when Phase 2 agent-Q&A surface ships per implementation-guide.md month 5+.

bot.name: Trading System Bot
bot.description: Posts signals/fills/alerts to the trading-system server; processes operator slash commands. Owned by operator.
permissions_explicitly_NOT_granted: MANAGE_MESSAGES (no message deletion — operator-deletes only; preserves audit-style append-only feel)
MANAGE_CHANNELS (no channel mutation — channels are managed manually)
intents_explicitly_NOT_required: MESSAGE_CONTENT (we use slash commands, not message-content parsing — privileged intent unnecessary)

secrets_schema_target: deploy/secrets.template.yaml under the `discord:` key of the host secrets file (/opt/trading-secrets/secrets.yaml).
